mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, weak labor market conditions suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for HOUST-RSAFS interaction < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day returns positive in < 45% of joint rising instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns positive in > 55% of monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns negative in > 55% of INDPRO rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600 thousand units for two consecutive months, housing market contraction reduces consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns positive in > 45% of HOUST < 600 instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market strengthening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS-UNRATE interaction < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns positive in < 45% of joint strengthening instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), persistent labor market weakness suppresses consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns positive in > 55% of UNRATE > 8.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
